instrument: Policy Recommendations for Accelerating Solarization of Agriculture through Agrivoltaics: Guidebook for Policy Makers
yield_rule: Limit maximum yield loss to 10-20%; restrict key staple food crops; limit to be refined from pilot data
land_use_rules: At least 70% of land under cultivation; not more than 30% under solar; plant size 100 kW-5 MW

instrument: Tapping the Potential of Agriphotovoltaics in India
issuer: Power Foundation of India (society under the Ministry of Power) with Climate Policy Initiative
yield_rule: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare should notify minimum yield thresholds 'in % of baseline yield' or cap yield loss, set by crop type, region (rainfed or irrigated) and season (kharif or rabi); scheme benefits (PM-KUSUM, VGF, tax-free farm income, crop insurance) conditional on meeting them
monitoring: periodic agricultural audits by state agriculture departments or third parties

instrument: National agrivoltaics policy (draft announced, not yet published)
issuer: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
yield_rule: No yield rule reported. Initial target about 5 GW in 3-4 years, possibly a 10 GW agri-PV component in PM-KUSUM 2.0; draft to be placed in the public domain for comments from states and stakeholders. Germany's yield-linked support cited as a model being examined
land_use_rules: Agriculture Minister: designs must preserve cultivation and allow machinery, ploughing and crop changes
verification: press reports only; no draft found on 2026-11-14

instrument: DIN SPEC 91434:2021-05 Agri-photovoltaic systems: requirements for primary agricultural use
issuer: DIN (referenced by the EEG for the agrivoltaic bonus)
status: standard (binding only where a law refers to it)
yield_rule: Agricultural yield after installation at least 66% of the reference yield
reference_baseline: reference yield: 3-year average on the same land or comparable published data (secondary sources)
land_use_rules: Land lost to the structure at most 10% (category I, overhead, clearance at least 2.1 m) or 15% (category II, interspace)
verification: secondary (Fraunhofer ISE 2022 guide; Rodl & Partner 2024); standard is paywalled

instrument: Agricultural Land Act Enforcement Regulations (temporary conversion for solar sharing) and MAFF guideline
issuer: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries
date: 2024-04-01 (criteria from the 2013 bureau notice moved into the ordinance)
yield_rule: Permit refused if unit yield falls by 20% or more; also refused if quality deteriorates markedly, if panel angle and spacing affect sunlight, or if machinery cannot pass
reference_baseline: regional average unit yield of the same crop in the same year
area_basis: per area of the farmland under the panels (posts converted separately)
land_use_rules: Deserted farmland: no yield rule since 2021, but the 80% rule applies at re-permit; larger projects need prefecture or national consultation
monitoring: annual cultivation and income reports; annual site surveys for problem and large projects; violators published (law of June 2024, in force April 2025); FIT/FIP payments suspended for violators since 2024
verification: read in MAFF briefing material (May 2025, pp. 5-8); 22% of facilities (927) had farming problems at end FY2022

instrument: Decret n. 2024-318 du 8 avril 2024 (Code de l'energie R. 314-108 to R. 314-123)
issuer: Government of France (implements art. 54 of loi APER 2023-175)
yield_rule: Mean yield per hectare on the agrivoltaic parcel above 90% of the mean yield per hectare on a control zone (or a reference standing in for one); the prefect may lower the share
reference_baseline: control zone: at least 5% of the installed area (max 1 ha), nearby, unshaded, same soil, climate and practices
area_basis: per hectare of the agricultural parcel
time_basis: mean yield; averaging period not stated in the decree
land_use_rules: At most 10% of the covered area lost to farming; coverage (projected module area / parcel) at most 40% for plants above 10 MWp unless a listed proven technology
monitoring: checks before commissioning and in the 6th year, then yearly, every 3 years (coverage below 40%) or every 5 years (proven technology); annual data to ADEME

instrument: Linee guida in materia di impianti agrivoltaici
yield_rule: No numeric yield threshold found; continuity of farming must be shown and monitored
land_use_rules: Agricultural area at least 70% of the total (A.1); module footprint ratio LAOR at most 40% (A.2); PV output at least 60% of a standard plant (B.2)
monitoring: monitoring of agricultural continuity and PV output
verification: secondary (project verification documents on va.mite.gov.it); a 30% yield-loss cap cited by PFI 2025 was not found

issuer: New Jersey Board of Public Utilities
yield_rule: No numeric yield threshold; land must stay in active agricultural use
reference_baseline: research control area: equal to the array area if the array is 3 acres or less, otherwise at least 3 acres
land_use_rules: No permanent agricultural structures or concrete footings
monitoring: data on crops, harvest dates and yields for all projects; a university research study on prime soils in agricultural development areas
verification: read in NJBPU rule-proposal session (2024-12-17) and order (Docket QO23090679)

instrument: SMART Agricultural Solar Tariff Generation Unit guideline (225 CMR 20.00)
issuer: Department of Energy Resources with the Department of Agricultural Resources
yield_rule: Continued agricultural production; shading at most 50% of baseline field conditions (SMART tool)
area_basis: every square foot under and around the array
verification: unverified: figures from draft guideline text via search; mass.gov refused automated access

instrument: Agricultural land solar rules (Council of Agriculture)
yield_rule: Proof of agricultural production with yield at least 70% of the average of the past three years
reference_baseline: own average yield of the past 3 years
land_use_rules: Ground facilities at most 40% of the applied land; shading rate at most 40%

instrument: Renewable Energy Expansion Act (EAG) agrivoltaic criteria
land_use_rules: At least 75% of land kept in agricultural use; at most 7% lost to the substructure
